show.description:
He was mocked as a poor mechanic. Insulted by his in-laws. Abandoned by his own family.
But Raghav Yadav returns. Not as the man they humiliated, but as the billionaire who will shake their empire. When the tables turn, who will bow down? The tycoons blinded by pride, or the man they once called worthless? Watch Now.
